payload.claim: The spec's Problem section 4 asks to "name the yielded count in source_mutated's docstring" (base lines :673-678). The docstring (lines 662-688) still only says the function yields a reason for "a `find` that is absent, and a `find` that matches more than once" without ever stating that those two reasons now carry the match count as data (a `witness.FindCount`) rather than being plain unproven text. The diff instead adds a 2-line comment immediately below the docstring's closing `"""` (the two lines right here) that names `witness.FindCount`, but leaves the docstring's own enumeration of the six non-applying cases unchanged, so a reader of the docstring alone still cannot tell that the last two of the six now behave differently (failing a declared mutant) from the other four (always unproven).
